MscL.note: M.tb MscL crystallized closed only; open is modeled. Single experimental state -> capacity from pore/tilt geometry, flagged single-state.

MscS.note: Classic closed(2OAU)->open(2VV5) pair, same protein E. coli.

Piezo1.note: Domed/curved blade cryo-EM (6B3R). Piezo imprints a membrane dome; single curved state -> intrinsic curvature from blade geometry.

OSCA1.2.note: Placeholder resting; will verify OSCA states.

TRPV4.note: TRPV4-RhoA complex (8FC7); single deposited state used here, single-state flag.

nhTMEM16 scramblase.note: Ca-free(6QM4)->Ca-bound(6QMB) opens the lipid groove; clean scramblase pair.

Synaptotagmin-1 C2AB.note: C2 domain; curvature sensing via Ca-triggered membrane insertion loops. Scaffold/sensor.

Epsin-1 ENTH.note: ENTH: helix-0 folds & inserts on PIP2 binding (1H0A) -> wedge. apo(1EDU) lacks helix-0. Documented insertion transition.

Amphiphysin N-BAR.note: Intrinsically curved BAR dimer scaffold; curvature from banana shape.
